history.dynasty: Modern (Sai Prakash Spiritual and Charitable Trust)
history.summary: The Sai Prakash Spiritual and Charitable Trust was formed on 26 June 1998 under Dr. Chandra Bhanu Satpathy; bhoomi puja took place on 6 October 2000 and pran pratishtha on Ram Navami, 21 April 2002. The 3344 sq m complex is built in the shape of a cave and replicates the Shirdi Sai Baba temple layout and key episodes of Baba's life in Shirdi, earning it the name 'Shirdi of North India'. The Sai statue sits under the original neem tree (Gurusthan), lit by oil lamps.

name: Sai Ka Angan
town_description: Gurugram (renamed from Gurgaon in 2016; the CSV uses 'Gurgaon') is a major corporate and IT hub adjoining Delhi in southern Haryana. Once a rural settlement, it grew from the 1980s into one of India's largest financial and technology centres, anchored by Cyber City and the NH-48 corridor. It has a dense urban population and heavy commuter traffic with Delhi.
